notes.title: Ver. 2.01 Update
notes.notes:
Hi All

We have just updated Strange Telephone with the following updates:

[list][*]Fixed bug causing displays for Endings, Library, and Settings to disappear (provisional).
*As we were unable to reproduce this bug in certain environments, we have fixed the process that was assumed to be causing this bug to occur.
[*]Fixed bug preventing scan line settings from being applied outside of the title screen and settings screen.
[*]Fixed bug causing "Kakukaku" to freeze.
[*]Fixed bug causing encounters with Geo-1 and Geo-2 to occur in reverse order.[/list]

[quote][h1]NOTICE[/h1]
Since we have fixed bugs concerning save data (provisional), updating from ver. 2.00 may prevent the game from loading properly (i.e.: save data may not load properly) in some environments.
If you experience crashes after loading the game or freezes in the loading progress bar, you may need to delete your save data.

Save data location:
C:\Users\[Username]\AppData\LocalLow\HZ3 Software\StrangeTelephone2.0\
Delete the "Data.hz3" file in the above folder.

The "AppData" folder is a hidden folder. Click "View" or "Display" at the top of Explorer, then find the "Show hidden folders" item and check the box to make hidden folders visible.[/quote]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/705290/Strange_Telephone/

--

notes.title: Set For Release on January 21st, 2019!
notes.notes:
The wait is almost over!

[i]Strange Telephone[/i] will be released on [b]January 21st, 2019[/b]!

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30645570/f31a2dbf62f118c30f66f7c396b375d815b1ccb0.png[/img]

Ver. 2.0 will feature a number of new additions, including the following:

・New ways to play the game (controller support, etc.)
・Newly added endings
・Even more worlds and objects added
・More items added
・Library (Object Viewer) added

We will also be updating the Developer's Voice and News sections with info on all the latest additions, so be sure to check them out and get ready for the long-awaited launch!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/705290/Strange_Telephone/

notes.title: Strange Telephone PC Version Coming Soon!
notes.notes:
Hi All! 

The PC version of this multi-ending 2D adventure game "Strange Telephone" is coming soon to Steam! Explore strange worlds generated by merely entering 6 digits entered into a phone. 
After gaining large popularity on iOS/Android, it was decided to bring the game to PC. 

http://store.steampowered.com/app/705290/Strange_Telephone/

The protagonist Jill is trapped in a dark world with a large door floating before her. She is aided by Graham, who takes on the form of a telephone. Making phone calls with Graham creates various worlds that can be explored. In each of these worlds are items to be found, including the key that will lead to her escape.


Version 2.0 will have the whole world rebuild/reconstructed, and overall volume is also greatly increased! Stay tuned!


Although the release is still a bit away, please add it to your wishlist to stay up to date! 
http://store.steampowered.com/app/705290/Strange_Telephone/
